basic_details.job_title: NID Assam Senior Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Design Assam (NID Assam) has announced 1 vacancy for the Senior Assistant (Finance & Accounts) post under its 2026 recruitment. The appointment is initially on contract and may be regularized based on performance and institute requirement. Candidates applying for the post must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce or equivalent from a recognized University / Institute, along with proficiencies in computers and uses of utilities, software, etc., and must be not exceeding 35 years of age as on the last date of application. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice advertises 1 Group-B administrative post. The category-wise distribution is detailed below: Candidates who had applied earlier against recruitment notice no. NIDJ/2026-27/Admin./Rectt./105/137 dated 25.05.2026 need not apply again.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce or equivalent from a recognized University / Institute. Proficiencies in computers and uses of utilities, software, etc. Relevant experience in Finance & Accounts related matters in Government / Educational Institution. Not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation and reservation benefits will be given to SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PwD / Ex-Servicemen / Government employees as per existing Central Government rules. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NID Assam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Institute’s Careers Page at https://nidj.ac.in/careers/ or access the Direct Samarth Portal Link at https://nidjnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login . New users must register by providing a valid email ID and mobile number, while existing users can log in with their credentials. Fill out personal details, educational qualifications, and work experience as required in the application form. Upload self-attested scanned copies of necessary supporting documents. Pay the application fee online through the Samarth Portal’s payment gateway, if applicable. Review all details before submitting the form and download and save a copy of the filled application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process may include shortlisting based on essential and desirable qualifications, followed by a written test and a trade test with proportionate weight-age. Mere fulfillment of minimum qualifications does not confer any right to be shortlisted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NID Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy is available for the Senior Assistant (Finance & Accounts) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for Senior Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce or equivalent from a recognized University or Institute with proficiency in computers, utilities, and software.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for the Senior Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application, with relaxations as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NID Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for OBC candidates. PwD candidates and other eligible exempted categories are not required to pay any fee.

faq.question: Q6. Is the appointment permanent from the beginning?
faq.answer: The institute reserves the right to offer appointments initially on contract, and candidates may be regularized based on performance and institute requirements.

faq.question: Q7. Do candidates who applied previously need to apply again?
faq.answer: Candidates who applied earlier against recruitment notice no. NIDJ/2026-27/Admin./Rectt./105/137 dated 25.05.2026 need not apply again.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the Samarth portal linked via the official NID Assam website.
